findings.evidence: The declarations volumeElement, volumeElement_def, volumeElement_eq_basis, volumeElement_neg_orientation, reverse_volumeElement, involute_volumeElement, star_volumeElement, volumeElement_eq, volumeElement_eq_inv_smul_basis, volumeElement_mul_ι_of_even/_of_odd, and volumeElement_mul_self use only real theory. summary: The real oriented volume API belongs below complexification in a dedicated volume-element module.
